units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:21">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:21">VIII</cite>), 21 <he>עמד ע׳ בגרונו</he> if a bone sticks in one’s throat; <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:17">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:11">Pes. VII, 11</cite> <he>השובר את הע׳ וכ׳</he> he who breaks a bone of the Passover sacrifice.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:12">Ib. 12</cite> <he>שאין בו משום שבירת הע׳</he> because the prohibition to break a bone does not apply to it; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲצָמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 8:8">Ib. VIII, 8</cite> <he>והמלקט לו ע׳</he> he who has the bones (of a parent) collected, v. <cite ref="L00677"><he>לָקַט</he></cite>; a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:14">Ab. I, 14</cite> <he>וכשאני לעַצְמִי וכ׳</he> and if I am (I care) for myself only, what am I? <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:13">Ib. II, 13</cite> <he>אל תהי רשע בפני עַצְמֶךָ</he> be not a wicked man in thine own sight (despair not of thyself).
<cite ref="Berakhot 43a">Ber. 43ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 4:8">Tosef. ib. IV, 8</cite> <he>כל אחד ואחד מברך לעַצְמוֹ</he> each says the blessing for himself.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:10">Zeb. VIII, 10</cite> <he>כשהוא בעצמו</he> when it (the addition to, or the diminution from the prescribed action) stands by itself (is clearly visible); <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28b">R. Hash. 28ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 100a">Erub. 100ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 19:1">Sifré Deut. 19</cite> <he>לא מעַצְמִי אני וכ׳</he> I did not say that of my own accord (as my idea), but at the command of God.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>; Tanḥ. Bal. 13 <he>בקש לילך לעצמו וכ׳</he> he wanted to go to himself (go home); a. v. fr.—Pl. constr. <he>עַצְמֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 16:2">Sifré Deut. 16</cite> <he>לשעבר … עַצְמֵיכֶם וכ׳</he> in the past you were your own masters, now you are servants and subjects of the community; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 111:15">Yalk. Gen. 111</cite> (ref. to <he>וַעֲבֻדָּה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 26:14">Gen. XXVI, 14</cite>) <he>וַעֲבָדָהּ כתיב אם אין אדם נעשה כעבד לעַצְמוֹ וכ׳</he> it may be read ‘and he shall serve it’, unless a man become like a slave to his stock, he does not own it; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:10">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> <he>כמו עבד לעבדו</he> (read <he>לעצמו</he>; cmp.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 58b:24">Snh. 58ᵇ</cite>).—Pl. as ab. Gen. R. l. c. (ref. to <he>עצמת ממנו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 26:16">Gen. XXVI, 16</cite>) <he>כל אותן ע׳ שעצמת ממני היה לך</he> all these possessions (herds and flocks) which thou hast obtained, are they not from us?; Yalk. l. c. <he>עֲצוּמוֹת</he>.
